name: Ano Toki Moshimo
source:
You win the national tournament with Meika, a budding martial artist who you met just by chance! 
But if you chose a different pathway in that moment...... The ending hinges on your choice!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229450.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你和Meika一起赢得了全国锦标赛，Meika是一位偶然认识的初出茅庐的武术家！
但如果你在那一刻选择了不同的道路……结局取决于你的选择！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229450.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
